lede: Project assurance and independent quality review provides a structured way to check deliverables, controls, and governance evidence against agreed quality criteria before defects, rework, and schedule slippage spread. This course develops practical skills in checklist design, deliverable inspection, findings logging, root-cause analysis, RAG status reporting, and assurance dashboard building. You will learn to review project artefacts objectively, document nonconformances clearly, trace evidence, and communicate findings in a form sponsors can act on. The training also introduces AI-assisted document comparison and summarization, helping assurance teams manage reviews across suppliers, dispersed teams, and fast-moving governance environments.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with project documentation, governance reviews, or quality checkpoints and need a more structured approach to assurance. It is especially relevant when you are responsible for review evidence, issue follow-up, and reporting quality concerns to decision-makers.
prerequisites: You should bring familiarity with project artefacts, quality plans, issue logs, and basic spreadsheet work. A laptop is recommended for the digital exercises, including dashboard building and review log preparation.
